description: This line plot illustrates the training loss over training steps for five different transformer-based models, all trained on a dataset of 20 million data points. The x-axis represents the training step, ranging from 0K to 440K, with tick marks at intervals of 20K, 40K, 60K, 80K, 420K, and 440K. The y-axis represents the train loss, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.85. The plot displays five distinct lines, each corresponding to a specific model configuration: ChemBART Small 20M (red line with circular markers), ChemBERTa Small 20M (blue line with square markers), ChemBERTa Medium 20M (orange line with diamond markers), ChemLLaMA Small 20M (purple line with triangle markers), and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown line with star markers). All lines begin near a train loss of approximately 0.75 at step 0K and exhibit a rapid initial decline, stabilizing around a train loss of 0.05 to 0.10 after approximately 40K steps. The green line (ChemBERTa Small 20M) remains consistently lower than the others throughout the training process, while the red line (ChemBART Small 20M) starts slightly higher but converges to a similar final loss. All lines show noisy fluctuations around their final stable values after step 40K.
